text:
Type: floral jacquard cushion cover
Use: decorative accent on a bed or sofa; bedroom, living room
Style: traditional, classic, glam
Materials: Egyptian cotton sateen jacquard, soft sheen, piped edge
Colors: pale French blue, chocolate brown and taupe pattern
Shape: square, all-over damask-style leaf and flower scrolls, piped edges, plump, medium size
Feel: elegant, refined, soft
Goes with: blue or ivory bedding, brown wood, silver accents; traditional or classic bedrooms and living rooms

product.name: Pinzon Fleur Jacquard Egyptian Cotton Sateen 18-By-18-Inch Pillow Cover, French Blue/Chocolate
product.description: Decorative pillow cover with an elegant Jacquard floral pattern; made in Portugal Made of 100-percent Egyptian cotton in a Sateen weave; 1-ply yarns; side slit opening Positive/negative reverse, with blue piping; coordinates with Pinzon Fleur Jacquard collection Machine washable and dryable; available in a choice of colors Measures 18 by 18 inches
